Services

What we do

Two capabilities under one roof: representation of components and systems, and full design, test and manufacturing services.

Representation and Distribution

Manufacturers of passive and active components and complete systems, represented in the Israeli and international market.

Design and Development

Hardware design and development, including high-speed communication circuits, from concept to a working product.

Electro-mechanical Solutions

Integrated electronic and mechanical assemblies for demanding communications, medical and defense environments.

Test Engineering

Final-test definition and functional test, to defense and medical standards (AS9100, ISO 13485).

Manufacturing and DFM

Design for manufacturability, production setup and cost reduction, from prototype to volume production.

Communications, Medical, Defense

Deep experience across high-speed communications, medical devices and defense and dual-use systems.

Capabilities

From component to tested product

The advantage

An operator, not an agent.

Most representatives hand you a contact list. HadTech brings a former CEO who reads your BOM, yield, sourcing, DFM and working capital, and knows how to turn a technology into qualified revenue in a demanding market.

Executive depth

More than 25 years of P and L, turnaround and M and A, including public company (TASE) governance and board leadership.

Engineering fluency

Hardware, NPI, SMT and reliability, from prototype to mass production. A partner who speaks your engineers' language.

Real access

Direct working relationships with Israel's defense primes, integrators and industrial and medical OEMs.

The foundation

A firm built on two decades in electronics

HadTech is a technology representation and commercialization firm. Its work rests on more than 25 years of executive leadership in advanced electronics and manufacturing, and on direct, working relationships across Israel's defense, industrial and medical industry.

Leadership

CEO and P and L experience, a turnaround of a 70 person manufacturer from receivership to a successful exit, and public company (TASE) governance.

Engineering

Hardware, NPI, SMT and reliability, from prototype to mass production, and global supply chains across Asia and the US (Marvell Semiconductor).

Industry network

Direct relationships with Israel's defense primes and integrators, and board roles in the Manufacturers Association of Israel.

Founded and led by Yaniv Hadar.
